title: Renewal invoices omit prior credits and balances
summary: Membership staff send renewal invoices that leave out credits and carried-over balances the member has already paid, so the amount due reads far higher than it should. Finance teams chase the difference manually every renewal cycle.

log.why: Nothing in the empty index covers renewal totals being calculated without amounts the member already paid or carried over, so this opens that theme.
A missing partial-year credit line is the same failure as a missing carried-over balance: the renewal total ignores what the member already paid.
